resume_document.headline: Junior Full-Stack AI Engineer | Flutter, Python & RAG Systems
resume_document.summary: Junior Full-Stack and AI Engineer experienced in building cross-platform Flutter applications, textbook-grounded RAG pipelines, and scalable REST APIs. Proven background delivering mobile features across commercial applications, optimizing backend query performance, and building Python-driven LLM and agentic workflows.

bullets.text: Integrated over 20 REST API endpoints, Firebase authentication, and realtime data feeds into commercial Flutter application workflows.
Contributed to cross-team development and maintenance across six Flutter applications featuring responsive UI widgets and backend connections.
Developed backend services using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB while structuring mobile codebases with BLoC and MVVM architectures.
Optimized learning-management database queries and indexing, cutting reported p95 API latency from 1,100 ms to 420 ms (a 62% reduction).
Enhanced Talib mobile dashboard loading speeds from 3.2s to 1.4s through structured caching, lazy loading, and pagination.
Worked on customer repair booking, user dashboard interfaces, and repair-status REST API integration journeys in Flutter.
Co-developed textbook-grounded RAG capabilities leveraging embedding-based semantic retrieval and FAISS vector indexing.
Developed Flutter student-facing learning experiences connected to backend APIs.
Implemented AI-assisted generation modules for quizzes, flashcards, and automated learning summaries.
Implemented Gmail attachment and direct-PDF intake, PDF parsing and extraction into structured candidate profiles.
Built deterministic ATS scoring logic evaluating required skills, experience indicators, and transparent candidate comparison breakdowns.
Implemented career data models, JSON persistence, job description parsing, fact retrieval, and LangGraph evaluation cycles in Python.
Designed and developed multi-tenant retail ERP and POS workflows in Flutter for inventory, POS sales, and repair tracking.
Implemented Supabase authentication, tenant data isolation using PostgreSQL row-level security (RLS), and secure RPC functions.
